title: Premium 3D glass panel LOGIN UI 😍
caption:
Premium 3D glass panel LOGIN UI 😍

🔮 Glass Login UI

🪟 Premium 3D glass panel. A real refractive glass slab built with Three.js. It has a thick prism-style bevelled edge, a frosted inner coat for a two-layer look, and chrome corner screws. You can switch between a sharp Square and a perfectly round Circle shape, and the panel spins and morphs when you change. 

✨ A light streak sweeps across the glass, and a light follows your cursor to make glints on the edges.

🌄 Living nature scene. The wallpaper is a procedural mountain lake with a sunrise, misty ridges, pine forests and a reflection, with no image files. 

🌙 A day/night toggle swaps it for a moonlit sky with stars. 

🧚 Fireflies drift upward, and the background shifts slightly as you move the mouse. 

🖱️ You can drag the glass to tilt it, and it springs back when you let go.

⌨️ Playful, polished form. Frosted white fields with black text keep it readable on transparent glass.

🫧 Each keystroke makes the panel bounce slightly and plays a soft tick sound.

🔐 A colour-changing password strength bar sits under the password field, and a lock icon shows or hides the password.

👤 The avatar pops when you click into a field.

🧲 The Login button follows your cursor a little and has a shine sweep on hover.

❌ Empty fields turn red, and the panel shakes with a low buzz.

💥 Glass-shatter login finale. On login the panel squashes and spins a full turn. 

🧊 240 translucent glass shards burst from the button with a synthesized broken-glass sound, and a “Welcome back, name ✨” message slides in. 

🧹 The fields clear themselves afterwards. 

🖱️ Clicking the background sprays small shards, and a 🔊/🔇 button mutes all sounds.
